scenes.description: Cheerful Teacher in the Sunny Classroom
Kind Doctor and Friendly Nurse at the Clinic
Brave Police Officer and Firefighter on the City Street

character_line.en: Welcome to our bright classroom! Who is standing by the blackboard?
character_line.zh: 歡迎來到我們明亮的教室！是誰站在黑板旁邊呢？

options.en: She is our kind English teacher!
options.zh: 她是我們親切的英文老師！

options.hint: 站在黑板前面教大家讀書的是親切的「teacher」喔！
告訴 Benny 黑板前面的是我們親切的英文老師喔！

character_line.en: Teachers are wonderful! What do you want to be when you grow up?
character_line.zh: 老師真的很棒！你長大後想成為什麼呢？

options.en: I want to be a singer and sing happily!
options.zh: 我想成為一名歌手，開心地唱歌！

options.hint: 分享你長大後想做的工作，說「I want to be...」喔！
告訴 Benny 你想成為一名開心的歌手或喜歡的職業！

character_line.en: Here is the town clinic! Who helps us when we feel sick?
character_line.zh: 這裡是小鎮診所！當我們生病時是誰在幫助我們？

options.en: The kind doctor and nurse help us!
options.zh: 親切的醫生和護理師幫助我們！

options.en: I play soccer in the yard.
options.hint: 生病時細心照顧我們的是醫生「doctor」和護士「nurse」喔！
診所裡有穿白袍的親切醫生跟護理師喔！

character_line.en: They take good care of everyone! Should we say thank you?
character_line.zh: 他們細心照顧大家！我們是不是該說聲謝謝呢？

options.en: Yes! Thank you for keeping us healthy!
options.zh: 對！謝謝您們守護我們的健康！

options.en: The train runs on the track.
options.hint: 有禮貌地向守護健康的醫生與護士說聲「Thank you」喔！
感謝醫護人員讓我們保持健康「healthy」喔！

character_line.en: Look at the busy street! Who helps keep our neighborhood safe?
character_line.zh: 看繁忙的街道！是誰在維護社區的安全呢？

options.en: The brave police officer keeps us safe!
options.zh: 勇敢的警察守護著我們的安全！

options.hint: 守護城市治安、維持交通安全的是勇敢的警察「police officer」喔！

options.zh: 我喜歡香甜的香蕉牛奶。
options.hint: 告訴 Benny 是勇敢的警察叔叔阿姨在守護大家喔！

character_line.en: All these community helpers work so hard! Aren't they amazing?
character_line.zh: 所有社區助手都這麼努力工作！他們是不是很了不起？

options.en: Yes, they are all our community heroes!
options.zh: 是的，他們都是我們社區的英雄！

options.hint: 讚美大家都是社區裡的了不起英雄「community heroes」喔！
回答「Yes!」肯定所有辛苦為大家服務的人們吧！
